title: hieracium × byzantinum
intro: Hieracium × byzantinum, commonly known as Mountain Transcendent or Mountain Daisy, is a hybrid plant species in the sunflower family, Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. Research suggests that Hieracium × byzantinum may have therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation, due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium × byzantinum may also possess antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
